name: @k1s0-ts-outbox/workspace
description: Workspace root for @k1s0-ts-outbox/* packages (core / react / react-native).

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix core && npm run typecheck --prefix react && npm run typecheck --prefix react-native
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix core && npm run build --prefix react && npm run build --prefix react-native
scripts.test: npm test --prefix core && npm test --prefix react && npm test --prefix react-native
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --prefix core && npm run test:coverage --prefix react && npm run test:coverage --prefix react-native
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:coverage
